judge.reason: The assistant declined to guess competitors and explained that a wrong set gives a misleading comparison. It named no competitor. It offered to take 1–3 URLs or to run a single-site assessment without the comparison. It did not say in so many words that compare is skipped unless the user supplies competitors, but offering the single-site assessment instead conveys that.

reply:
I haven't started the comparison because I can't pick the competitors for you, even though you asked me to. This tool has a firm rule that only you can name them. A comparison against competitors I guessed would look exactly like one against your real ones, and you'd have no way to tell it was wrong. You may worry about a site nobody would think of, or not about the one that seems obvious, and only you know which. There's also no saved target for Nimbus Notes that already lists competitors, so I have nothing to reuse.

You have two options:

1. **Send me 1–3 competitor URLs.** I'll confirm the plan and the time it will take, then run the comparison. It only looks at public pages: I won't log in, create an account or submit a form on any site.
2. **Skip the comparison.** I'll run a single-site assessment of https://example-nimbus-notes.test with `/understudy:run`, and you can add competitors later.

Which would you like?
